stem:
A particle moves along x–axis according to given position function x(t) = 10 + t<sup>2</sup> – 10t.
(i) The average velocity of particle in time interval from t = 0 to t = 10 seconds, is?
(ii) The average speed of particle in time interval from t = 0 to t = 10 seconds is?

assets.alt: Position–time graph in m and s: a parabola starting at 10 m at t = 0, dipping to −15 m at t = 5 s and back to 10 m at t = 10 s.
